create_corrblock: create a CorrBlock to compute all-pairs correlation pyramid between two feature maps
call_corrblock_coords: call a CorrBlock with coordinates to sample correlation values from the pyramid
compute_all_pairs_correlation: compute all-pairs correlation between two feature maps using CorrBlock.corr static method
create_alternatecorrblock: create an AlternateCorrBlock to build a feature map pyramid for efficient correlation
call_alternatecorrblock_coords: call an AlternateCorrBlock with coordinates to sample correlations using alt_cuda_corr
